texture_page.encoding: RGBA8, red = integer index 0..15 (divide sampled red by 1/255); no sRGB conversion; nearest filtering; GLB UV uses (native_uv+0.5)/256

coordinate_conversion: GLB position=(source_x,-source_y,-source_z), unscaled native units. TMDscale0. Native beam front source-Z becomes GLB+Z; rotateYPI when placing in Godot-Z direction.

native_lighting.normal_storage: main.glb and beam_shield.glb COLOR_0.r=normal_index/255; *_normals.png2xN stores converted native Q12 normal+4096 low RGB bytes atx0,high RGB bytes atx1. This survives Godot8-bit vertex color import exactly. Companion unlit.
native_lighting.matrix_stages: Quantized actor rotation, native per-axis scale (80020F34), light matrix product (80052F04/80048EAC), normal light transform, color matrix plus background, per-channel RGB modulation; right shift12 and IR saturation at every GTE stage.
native_lighting.rotation_adapter: Native roll uses literal ROM Q12 sine/cosine values without column normalization. The current port aim basis is separately quantized to Q12; this is not an emulator replay of original room actor angles.

main_palette.row_mapping: row=(visible_actor_tick-1)&15; palette index i = source[(i-visible_actor_tick)&15]; actorinit phase0, decremented before upload each active update

companion_palette.row_mapping: row=D_800B99DA&7 (global frame counter, not actor-local age)

rgba_palette_encoding: PSX RGB555 expanded by (v<<3)|(v>>2); alpha0 iff word==0, else255. Bit15=1 on every nonzero color; additive semi-transparency is selected by primitive bit1 and TPAGE ABR1, not alpha opacity.

shield.blend: ABR1 background+foreground; source has no fixed opacity factor
shield.backface_evidence: TMD flags4 lacks double-sided bit2; native G3/G4 emitters reject NCLIP<=0; recovered glTF doubleSided=false
shield.release: Subtract256 from Q12 intensity4096 per actor tick; multiply and rightshift12 each integer color channel separately, reaching0 at tick16; geometry remains full size
shield.verification: tools/verify_ed_beam_assets.py executes original MIPS function for all1536phases times17Q12release levels (26112cases)
shield.rendering_limit: Dedicated native affine RGB555 rasterization preserves the recovered foreground arithmetic. Display presentation intentionally filters that foreground and adds it to the full-resolution encoded scene without quantizing the background; camera projection and world visibility remain port adapters.

limits: Extracted exactly from local disc data and static disassembly; no original in-game emulator reference image.
The user requested smoother presentation: native foreground pixels are filtered over the full-resolution scene instead of reproducing nearest-neighbor RGB555 display compositing.
Modern camera projection, the authorized longer reach and whole-primitive visibility against the painterly world remain explicit port adapters; the original scene ordering table is not replayed.

dedicated_renderer.pixel_rules: Integer screen sampling and top-left coverage; affine UV/Gouraud gradients truncated to Q12 with attribute+0.5 initialization; transparent texel zero skipped; texture modulation and RGB555 quantization per primitive before saturating ABR1 accumulation.
dedicated_renderer.buffer: RGBA8 data: RGB bytes0..31 saturated foreground contribution, alpha255 coverage. The raw native buffer is unchanged; display samples it with linear filtering and no sRGB conversion.
dedicated_renderer.compositor: CanvasLayer after scene tone mapping and before HUD; filtered foreground RGB5/31 is added to the full-resolution encoded scene and clamped to1. Zero foreground preserves the scene exactly. Background pixels are neither downsampled nor quantized. HDR2D uses explicit display encode/decode.
dedicated_renderer.reference_verification: 20,000 deterministic triangles and81,920,000 pixels compared with unmodified DuckStation software rasterizer: zero RGB555 or coverage mismatches.
